# Nano Banana Canvas — Complete Product Documentation

> Visual AI workflow builder for creators and teams. The cloud-based ComfyUI alternative that requires no GPU.

## Product Overview

Nano Banana Canvas is a browser-based visual AI workflow builder. Users drag and drop AI model nodes onto a canvas, connect them with edges, configure parameters, and execute the entire pipeline in the cloud. It replaces local tools like ComfyUI with a zero-install, GPU-free cloud experience.

**Website**: https://nanobananacanvas.com
**Category**: AI Tools / Creative Tools / Workflow Automation

## Core Value Proposition

1. **No GPU Required**: All AI model execution happens on cloud infrastructure
2. **Visual Interface**: Drag-and-drop canvas (ReactFlow) instead of code or CLI
3. **Multi-Model**: Supports GPT Image 2, FLUX, DeepSeek, Gemini, and OpenRouter models in a single workflow
4. **Instant Start**: Sign up and start building — no installation, no dependencies
5. **Community**: Share workflows publicly, fork others' templates

## Supported AI Models

### Image Generation
- GPT Image 2 (OpenAI) — highest quality text-to-image
- FLUX (Black Forest Labs) — fast, high-quality open model
- Stable Diffusion variants via OpenRouter

### Language Models
- DeepSeek (V3, R1)
- GPT-4o, GPT-4.1
- Gemini Pro/Flash
- Claude (via OpenRouter)

### Video & Multimodal
- Video analysis pipelines
- Multi-step image-to-video workflows

## Feature List

- **Canvas Editor**: Infinite canvas with zoom, pan, minimap, node grouping
- **Node Types**: Text input, image input, AI model, output, conditional, loop
- **Execution Engine**: Async cloud execution with real-time progress
- **Template Library**: Pre-built workflow templates for common use cases
- **Version History**: Track changes to workflows over time
- **Collaboration**: Share workflows with team members
- **API Access**: Programmatic workflow execution via REST API
- **Credit System**: Flexible pay-per-use with free daily credits
- **Multi-language**: English and Chinese interfaces

## Pricing

- **Free Tier**: Daily sign-in credits, access to all models
- **Pro Subscription**: Monthly credit allowance + priority execution
- **Credit Packs**: One-time purchase, never expire

## Use Cases

### For Content Creators
- Generate consistent character designs across multiple images
- Build storyboards from text descriptions
- Create social media content pipelines (prompt → image → caption → post)

### For Marketers
- Ad creative generation at scale
- A/B test visual variants automatically
- Brand-consistent image generation with style nodes

### For Developers
- Prototype AI features visually before coding
- Test different model outputs side-by-side
- Build and share internal AI tools

### For Educators & Researchers
- Visualize AI model behavior
- Create reproducible experiment pipelines
- Document AI workflows for papers

## Comparison with Alternatives

### vs ComfyUI
- ComfyUI requires local GPU and technical setup
- Nano Banana Canvas runs entirely in browser, no installation
- Nano Banana Canvas supports multiple AI providers (not just Stable Diffusion)
- ComfyUI is free but requires hardware investment
- Nano Banana Canvas has a free tier with cloud execution

### vs Midjourney
- Midjourney is single-model, single-step (prompt → image)
- Nano Banana Canvas supports multi-step workflows with branching
- Nano Banana Canvas supports multiple models in one workflow
- Midjourney has no visual workflow builder

### vs n8n / Make.com
- n8n/Make.com are general automation tools
- Nano Banana Canvas is purpose-built for AI creative workflows
- Better UX for image/video generation pipelines
- Native AI model integration without custom API setup

## Technical Architecture

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4
- **Canvas**: ReactFlow v12
- **State**: Zustand v5 + TanStack Query v5
- **Auth**: Clerk
- **Payments**: Stripe
- **Database**: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite at edge)
- **Storage**: Cloudflare R2
- **Cache**: Cloudflare KV
- **Deployment**: Cloudflare Workers (global edge)
- **i18n**: next-intl

## FAQ

**Q: Do I need a GPU to use Nano Banana Canvas?**
A: No. All AI model execution runs on cloud servers. You only need a browser.

**Q: What AI models are supported?**
A: GPT Image 2, FLUX, DeepSeek, Gemini, and any model available through OpenRouter.

**Q: Is there a free tier?**
A: Yes. Sign in daily to receive free credits. All models are accessible on the free tier.

**Q: Can I use my own API keys?**
A: The platform manages API access for you. Credits are used per execution.

**Q: Can I share my workflows?**
A: Yes. Publish workflows to the community Explore page. Others can fork and customize them.

**Q: What makes this different from ComfyUI?**
A: Cloud-based (no GPU needed), multi-model (not just Stable Diffusion), instant setup (no installation), and built-in community sharing.
